title: Rails models emitted as database components

comments.author: os
comments.text: Observed behavior: Rails ActiveRecord models and concerns were emitted as database components, resources routes produced no API boundary, and Gemfile third parties such as Stripe were absent. Fix: keep model classes as evidence only, detect Rails route DSL boundaries, and map runtime Gemfile dependencies through canonical third-party detection. Proof: Ruby scanner tests pass (15/15), scanner builds and lints, and the consuming CLI suite passes (360/360). Commit: 4363d8ce2925e3457923432e3de1703e0f9ab46f.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Complete. Fix merged in scanner PR #84 (fix(scanner): model Rails runtime boundaries, merge commit d0be0320, 2026-09-24; fix commit 4363d8ce). Models stay evidence only, Rails route DSL gives an API boundary, runtime Gemfile gems map to canonical third parties. Covered on develop by tests/unit/core/ruby-scan.spec.ts.
